inventory.notes: Early return at the top of the constructor, with or without the pref: the engine never creates the security-state/intermediates client, so it registers no poller client, no sync observer and no poll-end observer, and no request is made for the collection. Mozilla's lines are untouched; the logic is in security/manager/ssl/stealth/StealthIntermediates.sys.mjs. The list comes from a file the core declares, written to cert_storage on profile-after-change by the component of that folder.
Hook building security/manager/ssl/stealth, which registers our profile-after-change component and installs StealthIntermediates.sys.mjs.
